detail.title: H590 7.1 Surround Sound USB Gaming Headset - Red LED
detail.overview: The Ant Esports H590 is a USB-wired gaming headset delivering immersive 7.1 surround sound through 50mm drivers, producing deep bass, clear mids and crisp highs across games, movies and music. A flexible, omnidirectional noise-cancelling microphone ensures clear voice communication even in noisy environments, while red LED lighting adds a bold visual accent to any gaming setup. Its sturdy yet lightweight frame features an adjustable head beam and soft protein-leather earmuffs for long-lasting comfort during extended sessions. Plug-and-play USB connectivity makes it instantly compatible with PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox One and laptops, with no drivers required for setup.
